description: This file defines the Autoloader class used for dynamically loading PHP classes based on namespaces and directory mappings in an OpenCart system.

classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: A class responsible for registering namespace-to-directory mappings and automatically loading PHP classes based on those mappings, implementing PSR-4 or a custom autoloading standard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that registers the autoload function and sets the default extension for autoloading.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a namespace and its associated directory path, with an option to specify PSR-4 compatibility.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a class file based on the class's namespace and class name using the registered directory mappings.
